usageNotes: Use this to configure or update the WebAuthn (FIDO2) relying-party settings for Proxmox Datacenter Manager's two-factor authentication. The `id` (relying party ID) and `origin` fields must match the domain users access PDM on — changing `id` invalidates all existing WebAuthn credentials, and changing `origin` or `rp` may also break them. Pass `digest` from a prior GET to guard against concurrent config changes.

examples.summary: Set WebAuthn relying party to match PDM's public HTTPS origin

tips: Retrieve the current config and its SHA256 digest via the corresponding GET endpoint before writing, then pass `digest` to prevent race conditions.
Set `allow-subdomains` to false when PDM is accessed only on one exact hostname to prevent credential reuse from unrelated subdomains.
Use the `delete` array to unset individual properties (e.g., remove a previously set `origin`) rather than sending a full replacement object.
Changing `id` is non-recoverable for existing hardware keys — users will need to re-register their security tokens.
